names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Αυγούστου, «Άγιος Ήρων ο φιλόσοφος», with the rank word and the epithet left off. The page glosses the name from Hera or from ἥρως, «ισχυρώς και ωραίος, όπως η Ήρα», and remarks that a famous mathematician of Alexandria in the first century before Christ bore it.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιος Ήρων ο φιλόσοφος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Serbian row already carries, and it is the same man: a philosopher who reposed in peace, whom the page connects, as this folder already does, with the Heron to whom Gregory the Theologian addressed a whole oration. saint.gr is careful that the connection is a guess and not a fact — «Ίσως είναι ο φιλόσοφος Ήρων, προς τον οποίον γράφει ολόκληρο Λόγο ο Άγιος Γρηγόριος ο Θεολόγος», perhaps he is the philosopher Heron — and that caution is carried into the life here. The page gives no year, so no `dates` object is proposed, and it prints no hymn of any kind. It notes that some menologia set beside him the memory of a martyr Heraïs, «Ορισμένα Αγιολόγια, αναφέρουν και τη μνήμη κάποιου μάρτυρος Ηραΐδου»; that Heraïs is not a line of the day listing and no folder is proposed for her here. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
